nodes.label: OpenAPI architecture rationale
nodes.rationale: Server-side OpenAPI generator already produces document from route registration. Client SDK consumes that document to generate typed C++ client code.

nodes.label: CRTP pattern for IoServiceBase rationale
nodes.rationale: IoServiceBase uses CRTP so concrete Linux/Windows backends implement do_* methods while call sites only see the interface. Thread-safety is single-threaded per instance; scale-out uses one IoService per thread plus SO_REUSEPORT.
